# `gate_resolve`

**Resolve a gate.** Resolve an open gate and unblock every task waiting on it.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Capability | `gate_resolve` |
| Side effect | `resolve` |
| Idempotency | natural |
| Retry safe | yes |
| Timeout | none |
| Preview | not supported |
| Defined in | [`src/commands/contracts/builtin.py`](../../../src/commands/contracts/builtin.py) |
